plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: What an organization can be put on: its prices before GST, the seats, WhatsApp numbers and storage it includes, and its modules.
plans.readOnly: Only a super admin can change plans and the policy.
plans.empty: No plans yet. Create the first one.
plans.nothingOnSale: No plan is on sale. Every plan is archived, so no organization can be put on one.
plans.archiveDescription: It is no longer sold: no organization can be put on it from now on. Organizations already on it stay on it.

planForm.createDescription: A tier organizations can be put on: what it costs and what it includes.
planForm.editDescription: A change applies at once to every organization on this plan. A price agreed with one organization is its own.
planForm.keyHint: 2-32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes, such as growth. It never changes.
planForm.name: Name
planForm.pricesHint: For the whole organization. Leave a cycle blank if the plan isn't sold that way.
planForm.extraSeatHint: For each seat above the plan's. Leave a cycle blank to sell no extra seats that way.
planForm.modulesHint: Staff, roles, settings, the audit log and documents come with every plan.

problems.keyInvalid: Use 2-32 lower-case letters, digits or dashes, starting with a letter.
problems.nameInvalid: Use a visible name of up to 60 characters.
problems.priceInvalid: Use an amount like 4,999 or 4,999.50, up to ₹2,00,00,000.
problems.priceRequired: Give a monthly price, a yearly price or both.
problems.seatsInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 10,000.
problems.whatsappInvalid: Use a whole number from 0 to 100.
problems.storageInvalid: Use a size in GB above 0, such as 25 or 2.5, up to 9,313.

policy.title: Subscription policy
policy.intro: How long a trial lasts when onboarding gives it no end, and how long an unpaid organization stays past due, then read-only, before it is suspended.
policy.changeDescription: The new days apply to every organization from today, counted from the day each state was due.

problems.trialDays: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 90.
problems.pastDueDays: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 90.
problems.readOnlyDays: Use a whole number of days from 1 to 180.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intro: Jobs that failed after their last retry, newest first, and the schedules that start jobs. A job holds ids, never anyone's details.
jobs.empty: No failed jobs. Every job has run, or is still being retried.
jobs.queueHint: Show one queue's failed jobs, such as documents.render-pdf.

schedules.title: Schedules
schedules.intro: The jobs started on a timetable, by their cron in their time zone. The worker and the console register theirs at every start.
schedules.consoleOwn: The console registers its own schedules at every start, so they have no Remove.
schedules.readOnly: Only a super admin removes a schedule.
schedules.removeDescription: Only for a job the code no longer has: a schedule the worker or the console still registers comes back at its next start. The removal is recorded in the platform log.

log.title: Platform log
log.intro: What platform staff and the platform's own jobs did, newest first. Entries keep ids and codes, never an organization's name, so they outlive a deletion.

organization.export-requested: Asked for an export of the organization
organization.export-expired: Deleted the organization's export, expired or withdrawn
organization.purge-requested: Asked for the organization to be deleted for good
organization.purge-skipped: Kept the organization: its deletion's checks failed

subject.exported: Exported what is kept about one person or record
subject.erasure-requested: Asked for one person's or record's erasure
subject.erasure-skipped: Kept a person or record: the erasure's checks failed

subscription.plan-changed: Moved the organization to another plan
subscription.paid-through-changed: Changed the day the organization is paid through
subscription.overrides-changed: Changed the organization's seats, price or modules
subscription.trial-end-changed: Changed the day the organization's trial ends

platform-staff.level-changed: Changed a platform staff member's level
platform-staff.password-reset: Gave platform staff a new temporary password

job.retry-failed: Tried to run a failed job again, and it didn't run

schedule.removal-failed: Tried to remove a schedule, and it stayed

staff.title: Platform staff
staff.intro: Who works on the platform. Support works with organizations; a super admin also manages plans, platform staff and permanent deletion.
staff.introWithTwoFactor: Who works on the platform. Support works with organizations; a super admin also manages plans, platform staff and permanent deletion. Everyone signs in with two-factor.

levelHints.support: Works with organizations: onboarding, subscriptions, impersonation, failed jobs.
levelHints.super-admin: Also manages plans, platform staff and permanent deletion.

addForm.title: Add platform staff
addForm.description: They sign in by email with a temporary password, then choose their own.
addForm.descriptionWithTwoFactor: They sign in by email with a temporary password, then choose their own and set up two-factor sign-in.
addForm.name: Full name

problems.nameInvalid: Use a visible name of up to 100 characters.

handover.intro: Give {name} these details to sign in:
handover.shownOnce: Copy them now: the temporary password is shown only this once.
handover.firstSignIn: At their first sign-in they replace this password.
handover.firstSignInWithTwoFactor: At their first sign-in they replace this password and set up two-factor sign-in.

changeLevel.title: Change {name}'s level
changeLevel.description: From their next call. A super admin made support keeps the impersonations they started.

resetPassword.title: A new temporary password for {name}
resetPassword.description: They are signed out everywhere, and the impersonations they started end. They replace it at their next sign-in.

remove.title: Remove {name} from the platform staff?
remove.description: They are signed out at once, and the impersonations they started end. Their address stays taken: they can't be added again with it.

dataProtection.title: Data protection
dataProtection.intro: Permanent deletion happens only here: export first, type the organization's code to confirm, then the console's job deletes it and the platform log keeps the record.
dataProtection.waitedTooLong: The job hasn't reported back after 10 minutes. It may have failed.
dataProtection.deleted: This organization has been deleted for good. Each of its exports stays for 7 days from when it was asked for.

exports.title: Exports
exports.intro: Everything the organization keeps, for it to take away: its tables, its people and copies of its files, as JSON lines. Each export is kept for 7 days, and outlives a deletion.
exports.preparing: Another export is being prepared, so you can ask again once it is ready. If it stays so, look for it in the failed jobs.
exports.asked: Export asked for. The console's job is preparing it.

purge.title: Delete the organization for good
purge.intro: Its tables, its people and its files are deleted, and can't be brought back. The platform log keeps that it happened, with its code.
purge.exported: An export finished in the last day
purge.notExported: Export the organization's data first: a deletion needs an export finished in the last day.
purge.confirmDescription: This can't be undone. The console's job checks everything again before it deletes anything.
purge.queued: Asked for. The console's job checks everything again, then deletes the organization.
purge.purged: Deleted for good: {rows} rows, {people} people and {files} files.

skipped.not-cancelled: Kept: the organization wasn't cancelled when the job ran.
skipped.no-recent-export: Kept: its export was over a day old, or withdrawn, when the job ran. Export again, then ask again.
skipped.unknown: Kept: the job found a reason not to go ahead. The platform log has the entry.

confirmation.label: Type {code} to confirm
confirmation.hint: The organization's code, exactly as shown.

subject.title: One person or record
subject.intro: On a DPDP request the organization passes on: export what it keeps about one removed member or one record of a person, give it to them, then erase it. Issued documents are kept as issued, as the law requires.
subject.recordTypeHint: Such as person, for one of the agency's customers.
subject.idInvalid: Use the id as the organization's records show it, such as 0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002.
subject.recordTypeInvalid: Use lower-case letters and underscores, such as person.
subject.exportedAt: Exported {when}. Its file links work for 15 minutes.

customer.name: Name
customer.counts: {leads, plural, one {# lead} other {# leads}} · {notes, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} · {enquiries, plural, one {# repeat enquiry} other {# repeat enquiries}} · {tasks, plural, one {# task} other {# tasks}}

subject.auditEntries: {count, plural, one {# audit entry} other {# audit entries}}
subject.eraseNeedsExport: Erase is offered once the export of this same person or record is shown below.
subject.eraseReady: Their export is shown below. Erase also needs it to be from the last day.
subject.eraseDescription: What the organization keeps about them goes for good: a member's sign-in details, or a customer's contacts and leads, with the notes and task titles on those leads; their files, share links, notifications, and what the audit log says of them. Rows naming a customer in an agency's Google Sheet stay in the sheet: ask the agency to delete them too. They won't be added again. It needs their export from the last day.
subject.queued: Asked for. The console's job checks again, then erases.
subject.erased: Erased: what was kept about them is gone.

skipped.organization-gone: Nothing erased: the organization was deleted.
skipped.no-recent-export: Nothing erased: their export was over a day old when the job ran. Export again, then ask again.
skipped.unknown: Nothing erased: the job found a reason not to go ahead. The platform log has the entry.
